"How to rank the table:
  Loads    - times actually loaded into memory (THE thrash signal - high = reloading constantly)
  Unloads  - times evicted from memory
  Requests - times the streamer asked for it (normally huge; near-camera files are re-requested every frame - NOT a problem)
